metadata.design: 30 unique adversarial cases: 10 dev and 20 heldout.
metadata.portion_note: Gram amounts are synthetic test values, not serving guidance or nutrition recommendations.
metadata.synthetic_evidence_note: All catalog records carry provenance_kind=synthetic_fixture. Compound product ingredient/allergen statements and nutrient values are not real-product facts; nutrients are null. Official source links support only the general allergen, food-state, and food-handling assumptions in references.
metadata.case_catalog_note: Each case has a tight catalog override with its selected records and four relevant distractors. A compatible runner should use the case-local catalog with the top-level shared catalog according to case_inputs semantics.

fda_major_allergens.title: FDA Food Allergies
fda_major_allergens.scope: FDA identifies milk, egg, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame as major allergens; this supports general category relationships only.

usda_fdc_scope.title: USDA FoodData Central API Guide
usda_fdc_scope.scope: USDA FoodData Central records describe food identity and composition; nutrient records do not establish allergen absence or branded compound product ingredients.

usda_fdc_chicken_states.title: USDA FoodData Central chicken breast search
usda_fdc_chicken_states.scope: Official FoodData Central search results distinguish raw and cooked chicken breast records; our catalog rows are synthetic.

usda_fsis_poultry_temperature.title: USDA FSIS safe cooking temperatures
usda_fsis_poultry_temperature.scope: FSIS advises cooking poultry to 165 F measured with a food thermometer.

usda_fsis_separation.title: USDA FSIS food handling
usda_fsis_separation.scope: FSIS advises keeping raw meat/poultry/seafood/egg and juices away from ready-to-eat foods and cleaning surfaces.

usda_peanut_synonym.title: USDA ARS peanut research publication
usda_peanut_synonym.scope: USDA ARS identifies peanut (Arachis hypogaea) as also known as groundnut; the case uses the scientific name to avoid ambiguity with other groundnuts.

fda_tahini_sesame.title: FDA Voluntary Disclosure of Sesame as an Allergen
fda_tahini_sesame.scope: FDA specifically recommends naming sesame when tahini is used; this supports the synthetic tahini-to-sesame relationship.

fda_casein_milk.title: FDA GRAS Notice 959
fda_casein_milk.scope: FDA notice describes casein as a component of milk proteins; used only to support the casein/milk relationship.

usda_albumen_egg.title: USDA FSIS What is an Albumen in Eggs?
usda_albumen_egg.scope: FSIS says the egg white is known as albumen; FDA allergen reference identifies egg as a major allergen.

fda_semolina_wheat.title: FDA Food Labeling Guide
fda_semolina_wheat.scope: FDA includes semolina (Triticum durum) among grains included in wheat for allergen labeling.

fda_soy_synonyms.title: FDA Food Labeling Guide
fda_soy_synonyms.scope: FDA guidance discusses soybean source naming and acceptable soybean synonyms for allergen labeling.
